capabilities: Sign selected images or PDFs into tamper-evident packages
Sign attachments in the current note
Embed an invisible authentication signal in signed files
Verify signed files using sig.json metadata and a passphrase
Connect and disconnect a WaveSign account via an integration token
disambiguation: Not a visible watermark or electronic-signature product; it embeds an invisible signal and returns sig.json verification metadata.
extras: Privacy-sensitive: selected files and operation passphrases are sent over HTTPS and processed on WaveSign servers; the signing engine is proprietary while the client is MIT-licensed. Signed PDFs are rasterized, losing searchable text, forms and annotations; uploads are limited to 25 MiB (media) and 1 MiB (verification JSON); lost sig.json cannot be regenerated. Only Windows is validated; the README recommends a separate test vault and lists BRAT/manual installation while community review is pending.
problem: Vault attachments such as images and PDFs have no built-in way to prove their origin or detect that they have been altered or shared out of context.

requires.name: WaveSign account (browser approval at wave-sign.com, 90-day revocable integration token)

summary: File-signing utility that creates and verifies tamper-evident authentication packages for images and PDFs, embedding an invisible signal and returning sig.json metadata.
